rubrics.title: Lab 12 — Explore Your Tweets with Gemini and RAG

criteria.description: Lecture — lec12.ipynb: generate and save embeddings for existing lab8.tweet_collection tweets; show embedding dimensions, matching vector-index settings, and readiness evidence.
Lecture — lec12.ipynb: compare keyword and semantic retrieval, display source IDs and text, and produce a RAG answer supported by checkable retrieved sources.

Lab — lab12.ipynb: state the chosen keyword, exact X API query, and research question; collect 50–200 unique new tweets (target 100) into lab12.tweet_collection with unique tweet.id, collection_meta, retrieval time, and count evidence.

Lab — lab12.ipynb: define a custom Gemini classification and its labels, save valid results, check five labels against original text, and report missing results; complete an original-field quantitative analysis and category summary with two DataFrames, two charts, and interpretations.

Lab — lab12.ipynb: generate embeddings and a ready vector index for lab12.tweet_collection; compare keyword and semantic retrieval, display source IDs/text and vector scores, and demonstrate source-based RAG answers plus one follow-up question.

Lab — lab12.ipynb: save supported, paraphrased, and insufficient-evidence questions with retrieved sources, answers, and the student's evidence checks; explain findings, limitations, AI use, and what was verified or corrected.
